extension.description: Exécutez GitHub Actions localement avec une interface visuelle
viewContainer.title: ACT Runner
configuration.title: Act/Run - GitHub Actions Visual locally
configuration.actPath: Path to the act executable (leave 'act' if it is on PATH)
configuration.defaultImage: Default Docker image for local execution
configuration.enableCodeLens: Show CodeLens buttons in workflow YAML files
configuration.maxHistoryRecords: Maximum execution history records (limited to 40 for performance)
configuration.secretsFile: Path to the secrets file (relative to the workspace)
configuration.envFile: Path to the environment variables file (relative to the workspace)
configuration.varFile: Path to the GitHub Actions vars file used by act --var-file (relative to the workspace)
configuration.language: Langue des messages et vues (auto suit la langue de VS Code)
